title: **Program Images need a value reference** — read_image, CUA screenshots, and values whose `{ type: 'image', attachment }` entries reference every result image yield `Image`s; other image-producing tools keep their declared values and automa...

attrs.text: **Program Images need a value reference** — read_image, CUA screenshots, and values whose `{ type: 'image', attachment }` entries reference every result image yield `Image`s; other image-producing tools keep their declared values and automatically attach their pictures as additional model context.

title: **Program Images require attachment path mapping** — the filesystem must map stored host attachments to readable program paths. `fs-ssh` has no such mapping, so read_image and CUA image adaptation rejects in that composition, while value-re...

attrs.text: **Program Images require attachment path mapping** — the filesystem must map stored host attachments to readable program paths. `fs-ssh` has no such mapping, so read_image and CUA image adaptation rejects in that composition, while value-referenced images stay raw JSON and reach the model as additional context.

title: **No built-in reset control** — the shipped Loader plugin does not expose its executor instance through a service, GUI control or SDK endpoint. Hosts needing reset must mount and retain `PtcExecutor` in their own composition; that integrati...

attrs.text: **No built-in reset control** — the shipped Loader plugin does not expose its executor instance through a service, GUI control or SDK endpoint. Hosts needing reset must mount and retain `PtcExecutor` in their own composition; that integration owns retries after a failed reset.

title: **PTC mode uses TypeScript, and presentation is per agent rather than per tool** — PTC execution requires `ctx.ptcRuntime.language === 'typescript'`; within one agent no tool can be native-only while another is ptc-only.

attrs.text: **PTC mode uses TypeScript, and presentation is per agent rather than per tool** — PTC execution requires `ctx.ptcRuntime.language === 'typescript'`; within one agent no tool can be native-only while another is ptc-only.

title: **PTC mode intermediate values are execution-local and unbounded by bytes** — they cannot be reconstructed from session replay and may exhaust process or worker memory; only the outer `run_code` output has the worker's configurable hard cap...

attrs.text: **PTC mode intermediate values are execution-local and unbounded by bytes** — they cannot be reconstructed from session replay and may exhaust process or worker memory; only the outer `run_code` output has the worker's configurable hard cap.

title: **State depends on the runtime**: the default backend starts fresh; Node `persistent-in-memory` execution and Script mode with `scriptPersistence: true` retain memory per live Agent. Agent disposal awaits release. Restart and execution fail...

attrs.text: **State depends on the runtime**: the default backend starts fresh; Node `persistent-in-memory` execution and Script mode with `scriptPersistence: true` retain memory per live Agent. Agent disposal awaits release. Restart and execution failures can clear memory; model-visible guidance explains how to recreate missing variables. Programs and results remain in the Session log, without serializing live objects.

title: **Concurrency policy is not an event gate** — `executionMode()` reads the resolved tool definition directly; plugins can only declare a classifier on definitions they own.

attrs.text: **Concurrency policy is not an event gate** — `executionMode()` reads the resolved tool definition directly; plugins can only declare a classifier on definitions they own.

title: **`tools/pre-execute` deliberately cannot rewrite `exec.arguments`** — logged and rendered args would desync from what ran; the rewrite design is [a proposed Agent Note](../../../.agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-06-30-pre-tool-input-rewr...

attrs.text: **`tools/pre-execute` deliberately cannot rewrite `exec.arguments`** — logged and rendered args would desync from what ran; the rewrite design is [a proposed Agent Note](../../../.agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-06-30-pre-tool-input-rewrite.md).

title: **Caller-defined subagent and workflow structured outputs remain object-rooted** — this is a consumer-level guard; the shared schema vocabulary and tool outputs support every JSON root.

attrs.text: **Caller-defined subagent and workflow structured outputs remain object-rooted** — this is a consumer-level guard; the shared schema vocabulary and tool outputs support every JSON root.

title: **`timeoutMs` on a definition is declarative only** — the registry never enforces deadlines; enforcement requires the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy` wrapper.

attrs.text: **`timeoutMs` on a definition is declarative only** — the registry never enforces deadlines; enforcement requires the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy` wrapper.

title: **Exact-match detection only** — canonicalization is a deep key-sort, so near-identical variants (a tweaked path, extra whitespace inside a value) evade the chain; fuzzy matching is rejected pending evidence of need.

attrs.text: **Exact-match detection only** — canonicalization is a deep key-sort, so near-identical variants (a tweaked path, extra whitespace inside a value) evade the chain; fuzzy matching is rejected pending evidence of need.

title: **Compaction does not reset chains** — a chain spanning a compaction checkpoint keeps counting.

attrs.text: **Compaction does not reset chains** — a chain spanning a compaction checkpoint keeps counting.

title: **Advisory only** — escalating to a blocking form at a high threshold is not implemented, though `PostToolDecision` already supports blocking.

attrs.text: **Advisory only** — escalating to a blocking form at a high threshold is not implemented, though `PostToolDecision` already supports blocking.

title: **No subagent chain-sharing** — chains stay isolated per agent; a parent and its subagent repeating the same call never combine.

attrs.text: **No subagent chain-sharing** — chains stay isolated per agent; a parent and its subagent repeating the same call never combine.

title: **Legitimate idempotent polling still draws nudges** past the thresholds — the pressure valves are the `thresholds`/`exclude` config.

attrs.text: **Legitimate idempotent polling still draws nudges** past the thresholds — the pressure valves are the `thresholds`/`exclude` config.

title: **Past the highest threshold a chain goes silent** — reminders fire only at exact configured counts, never beyond them.

attrs.text: **Past the highest threshold a chain goes silent** — reminders fire only at exact configured counts, never beyond them.

title: **Cooperative, never a hard kill** — the deadline only notifies via `exec.signal`; a tool that ignores the signal does not stop on timeout, the wrapper remains inside `await next()`, and the model receives no timeout result until downstream...

attrs.text: **Cooperative, never a hard kill** — the deadline only notifies via `exec.signal`; a tool that ignores the signal does not stop on timeout, the wrapper remains inside `await next()`, and the model receives no timeout result until downstream settles.

title: **No blanket budget** — only tools that declare `timeoutMs` on their `ToolDefinition` get a deadline; undeclared tools (the shipped `bash`, `read`, `write`, and `edit` declare none) have no registry-wide default.

attrs.text: **No blanket budget** — only tools that declare `timeoutMs` on their `ToolDefinition` get a deadline; undeclared tools (the shipped `bash`, `read`, `write`, and `edit` declare none) have no registry-wide default.

title: **Single-owner scope only** — the list belongs to the one calling agent session; subagent, shared, and swarm scopes are a deliberate cut, and a non-agent caller is rejected.

attrs.text: **Single-owner scope only** — the list belongs to the one calling agent session; subagent, shared, and swarm scopes are a deliberate cut, and a non-agent caller is rejected.

title: **The item shape is deliberately minimal** — `content` plus three-state `status`; whole-list replacement needs no stable id, priority, or active-form fields.

attrs.text: **The item shape is deliberately minimal** — `content` plus three-state `status`; whole-list replacement needs no stable id, priority, or active-form fields.

title: **Whole-list replacement is the only operation** — no partial updates, no read-back tool, and no per-item edits; the model must resend the entire list each call.

attrs.text: **Whole-list replacement is the only operation** — no partial updates, no read-back tool, and no per-item edits; the model must resend the entire list each call.
